amplitude_analysis.interpretation: Potential hydrocarbon indicators detected. Three significant amplitude anomalies suggest possible gas-bearing sandstones.

fault_detection.interpretation: Two moderate fault structures detected. Both dip toward the main trap. No sealing concerns identified.

lithology_classification.interpretation: Moderate gamma ray values with high resistivity indicate clean sandstone. Excellent reservoir potential.

fluid_identification.interpretation: High resistivity combined with moderate porosity strongly suggests oil-bearing formation. Water saturation estimated at 25%.

porosity_estimation.interpretation: Average 18.5% porosity indicates good primary porosity. Zones >25% porosity represent primary pay intervals.

permeability_estimation.interpretation: High permeability (6,300 md) indicates excellent flow capacity. Formation should produce at economic rates.

saturation_analysis.interpretation: 75% hydrocarbon saturation confirms productive formation. Limited water encroachment expected.

pressure_prediction.interpretation: Predicted pressure of 2,750 psi consistent with normal hydrostatic gradient. No pressure surprises anticipated.

trap_evaluation.interpretation: Structural trap geometry is well-defined with 85% seal integrity. Multiple faults provide compartmentalization.

volumetric_estimates.interpretation: Conservative volumetric estimate of 6.2 MMbbl recoverable oil. Upside potential if traps are connected.

seal_integrity.interpretation: Thick shale seal (200m) with high integrity score. Minimal risk of vertical leakage.

key_findings: Seismic shows three amplitude anomalies consistent with hydrocarbon accumulation
Well logs confirm 18.5% average porosity with 75% hydrocarbon saturation
Trap geometry is well-defined with 85% seal integrity
Estimated 6.2 MMbbl recoverable oil with upside potential
Formation pressure within normal range - no drilling hazards expected

technical_recommendations: Acquire 3D seismic over adjacent lease blocks to delineate trap extent
Design horizontal well to maximize pay exposure (estimated 400ft vertical thickness)
Implement logging while drilling (LWD) to optimize real-time drilling decisions
Plan water injection study post-drilling to assess reservoir connectivity
next_steps: Finalize well design and AFE (4 weeks)
